name: Lars
summary: At a camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank, Lars struggles to survive Duskwood with Sven Yorgen. The woods around them hold beasts, undead, and worgen.

sections.title: A Precarious Perch
sections.body: Lars keeps to a small camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank, away from the uncertain safety of Darkshire. Duskwood is dangerous, and the surrounding woods hold ferocious beasts, undead, and worgen. He stays close to Sven Yorgen, trying to survive in the hostile forest.

sections.title: Threat from the Wilds
sections.body: Starving dire wolves prowl the woods around Lars and Sven's camp. Lars cannot keep watch or drive them off alone, so he depends on travelers to thin their packs before the predators overrun the camp.

faq.answer: Lars is a human survivor camping in Duskwood with his companion Sven Yorgen. They struggle to endure the forest's dangers on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank.
Lars stays at a small camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank in western Duskwood.
Hungry dire wolves and other predators threaten Lars and Sven's camp. Lars asks passing travelers to hunt the wolves before they overrun it.

faq.q: What is Lars's relationship to Sven Yorgen?
faq.answer: Lars and Sven Yorgen are companions surviving together in the wilderness. Sven has a dark history and a vendetta in the region, while Lars helps keep their isolated camp going.

angles.text: As a champion of the Alliance, you can help Lars, a human civilian beyond the town guard's reach, by driving off the wolves circling his camp.
